source.title: Epic Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
source.description:
Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of great power?

I must warn you; epic purchases made at revered reputation with the Dawn are still quite expensive. I would advise that you gain a better reputation with the Dawn before moving forward with your plans.
source.objective: For 45 Insignias of the Dawn and 45 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
source.progress: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.
source.completion: Good day, <name>. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
